result.reason: The operative language substantially reaches the preferred position: it provides Vendor indemnity for third-party IP, legal-compliance, Vendor-caused data-breach, and gross-negligence/wilful-misconduct claims; protects Customer and its Affiliates; includes notice and defence control; supplies IP remedies; and narrowly limits Customer's indemnity. However, it omits the required cooperation procedure. It also fails to designate the new provision as Section 20.5, leaving Section 9.3's cross-reference technically dangling; the parenthetical “(Section 20.5 remedies)” is not an adequate section number. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated terms.
